moments.author: Donald Trump
moments.quote: I could say the stupidest things and you’d clap
moments.why: He openly mocked his own supporters’ loyalty at a Tennessee rally — and it instantly went viral.

moments.author: Pete Hegseth
moments.quote: I support the death penalty, especially for terrorists
moments.why: His announcement that the Fort Hood shooter’s execution would be livestreamed sparked outrage and quickly trended.

moments.author: Hasan Piker
moments.why: Piker’s defiant post amid heightened political targeting resonated widely, driving debate across the platform.
